correctness.rationale: Since W contains all three pure squares, its coefficient quadrics are basepoint free and X is a projective-plane bundle over P2; adjunction gives -K=H1+3H2. Picard rank two and unequal dimensions h0(H1)=3,h0(H2)=4 force every abstract automorphism to extend and to be a projective stabilizer of W. The annihilator pencil has a four-point projective frame for t != 0 (stabilizer S4) and disjoint line-plus-point base scheme for t = 0 (stabilizer GL2). Its tangent quotient is [Hom(Sym^2 V,V)/V*] = Sym^3 V* tensor det(V), of dimension four. The first-order determinant derivative onto binary cubics has rank four; the independent checker reconstructed the frame and derivative ranks. This proves the displayed family and first-order normal representation, not a complete moduli deformation theory.
